title: Consecutive Characters
summary: Determine the power of a string by finding the longest substring with a single repeating character.
statement: Determine the power of a string by finding the longest substring with a single repeating character.
constraints: Power is the maximum length of a non-empty substring containing one repeated character.
hints: Track the length of the current equal-character run.
Extend it when the character matches the previous one; otherwise reset to one.
Update the maximum after each character.
Every constant substring lies inside exactly one maximal run, so the longest run is the answer.
editorial: Every constant substring lies inside exactly one maximal run, so the longest run is the answer.

tests.explanation: The longest runs are ee and consecutive c characters, each length two.
The five consecutive e characters give power five.
